n7fa19d0e4c.headline: Ammonnews : Arab tourists coming to Jordan spend JD1.418 bln in 7 months
n7fa19d0e4c.summary: Data from Jordan's Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities show Arab tourists are the highest-spending visitors to the country. They spent JD1.418 billion in the first seven months.

nafa50475a2.headline: Angola: Where is Isabel dos Santos' money?

nafa50475a2.why: Isabel dos Santos is a former Angolan executive whose assets became the subject of cross-border legal action tied to alleged state-linked wealth.

n169fecb611.headline: We will not back COCOBOD's decision to self-finance purchase of cocoa beans - Minority
n169fecb611.summary: Ghana's parliamentary minority says it will not back the Ghana Cocoa Board's decision to self-finance cocoa bean purchases by raising funds from domestic cocoa traders.

n5eab2202f4.headline: Indonesia needs energy transition in almost all sectors: Ministry
n5eab2202f4.summary: Indonesia's Coordinating Maritime Affairs and Investment Ministry warned that economic growth could be hampered if the energy transition is not carried out in almost all sectors.

n610ec1b4bf.headline: Greek-flagged Tanker Vessel Crew Forced to Abandon Ship
n610ec1b4bf.summary: The crew of the Greek-flagged oil tanker Sounion abandoned the vessel after it was attacked in the Red Sea. The crew were taken to Djibouti.
n610ec1b4bf.why: Attacks on tankers in the Red Sea disrupt shipping through one of the world's main oil and container trade routes. They raise freight and insurance costs.

n5edbe48257.headline: Trade war intensifies as EU to slap extra tariffs on Chinese-made EVs
n5edbe48257.summary: The European Commission has announced plans to impose tariffs of up to 36.3% on Chinese-made electric cars. The move escalates a trade dispute between the EU and China.

n5edbe48257.why_moved: Proposed tariffs of up to 36.3% on Chinese electric cars raise import costs and signal an escalating EU-China trade conflict.

n9a0c9eb25d.headline: Absa Kenya to expand agency services network to 17,000 outlets in two years

n6b4f5e8651.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif launched the Buna-Raast Connectivity Project. It links Pakistan's Raast digital payment system with Buna, established under the Arab Monetary Fund, to streamline remittances.
